title: Quality Studio rule overrides
description: A repository's adjustments to the built-in rule catalogue, read from .quality/rules/overrides.json (project scope), <data root>/rules/overrides.json (global scope) or rule-overrides.json in a registration's global inputs directory (shared global scope, read-only). Later layers win by rule id: global, shared global, project.

id.description: A rule id present in the resolved pool: the built-in catalogue or a custom rule of the global or project scope. An unknown id is an error, not a no-op.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is injected into reviews of this repository.

severity.description: The severity findings for this rule are reported at, replacing the authored one.

reason.description: Why this repository departs from the default. Required, and carried into the prompt when the severity changes.
